# @nuvoui/core design tokens

<!-- Generated file. Do not edit by hand. -->

This file is generated by `scripts/token-reference.mjs` from `src/styles/build.scss` with the default configuration. Regenerate it with `npm run docs:tokens` after changing any colour, theme or scale configuration.

Total: 327 custom properties: 244 fixed tokens in the `:root` block, 83 theme tokens in the light block (`:root, [data-theme="light"]`), 83 redefined in the dark block (`[data-theme="dark"]`, also applied through `prefers-color-scheme: dark` to `:root:not([data-theme])`). `[data-theme="inverse"]` takes the dark values on a light page and the light values under a dark page.

Tiers:

- **palette, basic, scale (fixed)**: the same value in every theme. Defined once in the `:root` block, so a runtime `:root` override applies inside light sections too.
- **theme, role (flips)**: redefined in the dark block. Role tokens point at a different stop of their own scale per theme.

Values are shown as emitted. A value that references another token is shown as that token, followed by the value it resolves to in that theme. A consumer configuration (`$brand`, `$light-theme`, `$dark-theme` and the scale maps) changes these values; this file documents the defaults.

The default values may still be tuned in a 2.x release (contrast and palette steps are under review). Read tokens through `token()` so a rename fails at compile time.

Read a token in SCSS with `token(name)`, which returns `var(--nu-name)` and raises an error for an unknown name.

## Brand

The bare role name (`brand`) is the solid fill, `-hover` and `-active` its states, `-subtle` a tinted background, `-border` a soft edge. `text-brand` is brand-coloured text on a page; `text-on-brand` is text placed on the `brand` fill.

## Non-colour scales

Emitted from the configuration maps. Mixins and utility classes output these tokens for configured keys (`p(4)` gives `padding: var(--nu-space-4)`); custom values stay raw. Decimal keys use `_` in token names (`--nu-space-0_5`).
